analysis.reviewNote: Direct support from the supplied synthetic passage, not model memory.
Direct support; evidence must preserve Arabic diacritics exactly.
Empty supplied evidence permits no claim based on model memory and no invented citations.
Empty evidence must yield insufficient evidence, not contradiction or absolute falsehood.
A single example cannot support a universal assertion; do not label it contradicted without direct conflicting wording.
